[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Hork''' commanded a [[Sergeant Hork's platoon|platoon]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He commanded his unit during an [[Unidentified battle (Imperial strongpoint)|operation]] to take an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] strongpoint.
